But now that I have contacted Wei Mian about the situation, it seems that things are not exactly like this. What kind of person is the old man? If he is the most serious There are people in the organization who want to be dishonest, will he not clean up the door? Impossible, absolutely impossible to remain indifferent. An Shenxu lowered his head and said, "I'm very busy, I don't have time." After saying goodbye, he said goodbye to the tribesmen and came to an open field. Although it was a wilderness, there was still green grass here, but one after another ghosts passed by. Hearing the faint sound of footsteps going up the stairs, Peter took action immediately. . After a run-up, he jumped off the roof and disappeared into the night. The Yong'an Army's first team had a shortage of more than 100 people in the last battle, so this time Xiao Yi said that the soldiers of the Zhenwei Battalion who performed well in the drill can also be credited. After counting the performance of previous drills and duty, he selected the best to join the Yong'an Army. He asked Ying to say that his troops were capable and could capture Shennong alive. Haven't you heard of it? "Shangguan Mingjing comes from a famous family, so he has seen a lot of martial arts. Unfortunately, he has searched through his memory and can't find this magical power. Temples are built for people with great merits in both the world and the underworld. These people may protect them. Helping one side may benefit Yin and Yang. Compared with Liu Sheng's laughter, Gao Shan had a look of disbelief and his whole body was shaking with excitement. He never thought that he could be a battalion officer. When he realized it, he immediately followed Liu Sheng to receive the order.
